posts.title: Google is Shattering Under Its Own Weight (The IBM-ification of Google?)
posts.description: I used to think Google owning the full vertical stack was a masterstroke. Like TSMC silicon, TPUs, their own data centers, proprietary models, search engine. Who else has that?? Nobody. I thought it was an unbeatable fortress. I was dead wrong. Look at the Railway GCP account ban situation.
